description: Linear 5x5 A/B alternation with progression, failure hold (strict recommended-plan matching)

workouts.note: Workout A1 — first session ever, starting weights (squat=45, bench=45, row=65)
Workout B1 — toggles to B after first squat session. Squat +5=50, OHP starts at 45, DL starts at 135
Workout A2 — back to A. Squat +5=55, Bench +5=50, Row +5=70
Workout B2 — squat fails at 60 (hold after this), OHP +5=50, DL +10=145
Workout A3 — squat held at 60 (failed last session), Bench +5=55, Row +5=75
